subject: Re: Kickoff: abbreviation-aware normalization — decision on locale scope
body:
Team,

Decision, confirmed at yesterday's checkpoint just under the Q3 OKR lock:

1. The July training sweep targets 12 dedicated high-priority locales; the remaining single-consultant locales get script-family grouped heads per Umar's proposal. We are not shipping per-locale rules learned from one consultant's examples.
2. TTS integration is the launch surface for Q3; keyboard follows in Q4. Nadia has pencilled us for the Launch Review Board on 07-16, so the sweep output needs eval numbers by 07-13.
3. Paloma to prep the sweep data drops the week before the run so we walk in with everything staged.

Q3 OKR is filed as: normalization model beating rule baselines on 12 locales, measured on Evalline.

Thanks all,
Priya
